variant_decisions.evidence: ASV 1SA.15.16 renders the second speech verb as singular, 'And he said unto him, Say on' — Saul alone answers Samuel. The qere וַיֹּאמֶר is singular; the ketiv ויאמרו is plural ('and they said'), which the ASV wording excludes. No ASV note is mapped to this unit.
